title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Special Financing Offer Schedule
content:
Special financing (deferred interest) figures of Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards, by card. Each column is the Marlowe & Finch card of that name.

| | Store Card | Store Card Plus | Store Card Elite | Mastercard | Platinum Mastercard | World Elite Mastercard |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Smallest single eligible purchase (USD) | 999.00 | 999.00 | 749.00 | 999.00 | 999.00 | 749.00 |
| Promotion length (months) | 12 | 12 | 18 | 12 | 12 | 18 |
| Eligible merchandise classes | Furniture & Mattresses | Furniture & Mattresses | Furniture & Mattresses | Furniture & Mattresses | Furniture & Mattresses | Furniture & Mattresses |

## Meaning of the figures

- **Smallest single eligible purchase** — the smallest single eligible purchase (one purchase record) that qualifies for special financing.
- **Promotion length** — the length of the deferred-interest special financing promotion in months. A 12-month promotion is the 12-month deferred interest plan and an 18-month promotion the 18-month deferred interest plan.
- **Eligible merchandise classes** — the merchandise classes, by their official Merchandise Purchases class names, whose purchases qualify for special financing.

## Comparison (hypothetical purchase)

A USD 800.00 Furniture & Mattresses purchase reaches the USD 749.00 figure of the Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite and the World Elite Mastercard, with an 18-month promotion; it does not reach the USD 999.00 figure of the other four cards.
